name: What Is Owed

outcomes.description: Valentine met Barrois, and looked despairingly at the old servant.

stages.description: M. Noirtier, my master, wishes to speak on important subjects to M.

objectives.text: The red purse, on the mantel, as it once was.

stages.description: Valentine blushed, but did not answer. Villefort, approached Noirtier.

objectives.text: One life kept out of the ledger.

stages.description: Noirtier answered only by a look which made Villefort’s blood run cold.

objectives.text: Leave one man alive to be old.

stages.description: Perugino sometimes makes his Virgins, and her eyes dull from fatigue.

objectives.text: Write the letter, and leave it on the island.

summary: Vengeance keeps accounts. So does the other thing.
